summary: Module 2: SpatialDataFusion class. Accepts raw CPCB station DataFrames and NASA FIRMS fire points. Implements both IDW (Inverse Distance Weighting) and Ordinary Kriging spatial interpolation onto a 70x80 1km grid over Delhi NCR bounding box. Computes smoke transport vectors from fire pixels to grid center using U/V wind components and haversine distance. Returns xarray DataArrays for downstream tensor building.
